versions.changelog:
- Updated the default value of the DOUYIN_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS environment variable to be empty in documentation.
- No other user-facing or functional changes detected in this version.

- No file changes detected in this version.
- No visible updates or modifications from the previous release.

- Initial release of douyin-daily-report skill.
- Automatically generates and emails a daily Douyin trending video report (Word document) twice daily (08:00, 16:00).
- Full pipeline: fetches Douyin Top15 from TikHub → OpenClaw LLM analysis → Word export → email with .docx attachment.
- Includes all dependencies; setup script simplifies installation and cron scheduling.
- Supports custom email recipients and analysis count via environment variables.
- Provides troubleshooting steps and clear file structure for easy management.
